description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the PimDefinedReportDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various CRUD operations related to PIM reports, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of reports within the Pim module, with a focus on the report generator DAO.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ReportGeneratorDao related to PIM defined reports within the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up initial data for all tests by populating fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new ReportGeneratorDao instance and populates its fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of PIM defined reports.

methods.name: testDeletePimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests the deletion of specified reports by IDs.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific report by ID and verifying its attributes.

methods.name: testSavePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests saving (creating) a new PIM defined report with filters and display fields.

methods.name: testUpdatePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests updating an existing PIM defined report with new data.
